messages:
Maya (Acct): Heads-up: Limelight wants a quick perf POC to justify procurement. Scope: text-gen baseline for a 7B open model, 100-token responses, test profile: 50 qps smoke, 300 qps sustained for 20m, and 900 qps microbursts for 30s. They care about p95 < 150ms, p99 < 350ms. Any blockers?

Ravi (Solutions): Got it. A few clarifying Qs: mixed precision or float16? Are prompts mostly unique or highly repeated? Do they need encrypted keys (KMS) or private network?

Maya (Acct): Client prefers float16. Prompts are mostly unique but reuse some templates. They asked for KMS and audit logs; private network is optional. Single region (us-east) ok.

Elena (SRE): Proposed runbook: 1) quick smoke at 50 qps 5m, 2) warm ramp to 300 qps over 5m then hold 20m, 3) burst ramp to 900 qps over 10s hold 30s, 4) cooldown. Prewarm: 10m with synthetic traffic to populate caches. Telemetry: detailed p50/p95/p99, queue lengths, instance cpu/gpu, and reject/drop counts.

Nikhil (Eng-ML): For 100 tokens, recommend batching target 8-16 depending on latency. Use q4_0 quant if they want lower cost; expect ~1.5x throughput improvement but p99 might shift a bit. We'll include both float16 and q4_0 variants in the run. Also recommend a small set (10) of canonical prompts to check quality drift.

Ravi (Solutions): Draft cost ballpark for Hosted: ~ $900-1,800 for a 3h test (compute + token bill + egress). If we use quant variant and shorten soak we can hit under $1k. Need approval from finance for any Dedicated demonstration pricing.

Taylor (Security): Security checklist: TLS enforced, KMS for model artifacts + logs, role-based access to POC dashboard, and audit log export. Need to confirm retention period (default 90d). Any data retention or deletion requests from Limelight?

Maya (Acct): They asked for 30d log retention and ability to delete PII on request. Also procurement asked whether this could be done under our standard SOW or needs an MSA addendum for KMS keys.

Elena (SRE): No technical blocker for 30d retention and delete workflow. We'll generate a one-off pool with limited lifetime and key rotation schedule. DeployBot will create the pool and a telemetry dashboard.

DeployBot: Created ephemeral pool: pool-id pcp-1723456789, region us-east-1, max-instances 10, lifetime 8h. Dashboard: /dash/pcp-1723456789.

Nikhil (Eng-ML): Sample vegeta command for warm stage:

```
echo '{"method":"POST","url":"https://api.redwood/v1/generate","body":@req.json}' | vegeta attack -rate=300 -duration=20m | vegeta report
```

For burst stage use `-rate=900 -duration=30s`. We'll attach request.json with 100-token gen and example prompts.

Ravi (Solutions): Runbook notes: set autoscale min=2, max=10, coldstart priming to avoid first-request spikes, enable prefix caching for template prompts. Also set client-side retry to 2s backoff and circuit-breaker at 5xx rate >1%.

Taylor (Security): I'll draft a one-page security summary (KMS, retention, access controls) and include SOC2 snapshot. Maya, ask Limelight to sign off on deletion SLA.

Elena (SRE): Quick micro-sim numbers (internal harness): float16 baseline at 300 qps -> median 60ms, p95 130ms, p99 300ms; q4_0 quant at same config -> median 42ms, p95 95ms, p99 220ms. With burst to 900 qps we see p99 spikes to ~480ms for float16, ~320ms for q4_0, but drops/retries increase if autoscale caps hit. CSV attached to thread.

Maya (Acct): Those look promising. Can we guarantee p95 <150ms on float16 at 300 qps? Needs to be in the note to procurement.

Nikhil (Eng-ML): We can commit to p95 <150ms for float16 at 300 qps if we use autoscale headroom (max-instances 10) and enable batching=12. We'll note caveats: transient spikes during burst and coldstart.

Ravi (Solutions): Cost optimization proposal to keep it < $1k: short prewarm (5m), use q4_0 for primary run, shorten sustained hold to 15m, and reduce burst hold to 20s. Will update pricing calc and share a one-page cost summary.

Taylor (Security): Also confirm whether Limelight wants key ownership (customer-managed keys) or Redwood-managed keys. If CMKs, need an MSA clause.

Maya (Acct): Talking points for kickoff: 1) technical scope & runbook, 2) cost < $1k target, 3) security one-pager, 4) expected deliverables (latency heatmap + CSV + recommendation). I'll schedule kickoff tomorrow 11am ET.

Elena (SRE): One more ops note: capture GPU utilization during burst and the queue length histogram. If we see >80% GPU util for more than 30s, we'll flag and abort the burst.

DeployBot: Telemetry hook enabled: trace-id -> /dash/pcp-1723456789/traces. Logs retention set to 30d for this pool.

Maya (Acct): Thanks team. Action items: Ravi updates cost sheet (<24h), Taylor security one-pager, Nikhil finalizes attachable request.json and CSV, Elena preps pool and dashboard. I'll confirm client kickoff. :raised_hands:
